about_the_game:
Bend the rules of time to your whim to outsmart and out-think your opponents.

This simplified demo gives people a taste of The Time Game.

A challenging, animated, 2-4 player strategy card-game (with a solo-mode) which will have you wanting to loop back, time and time again!

Play through the tutorials and basic puzzles or with friends.

Dev notes

With this Demo we'd love to have the opportunity to get more play-testers and feedback from anyone who picks up this free-to-play game. This Demo has a basic card pool and simple puzzles. You can also play multiplayer with friends but public lobbies are not available in the Demo. The locked parts are being worked on, with the intention to release these for Early Access.  By sharing a lobby code you can join a friends game. Demo is only in English. We plan to receive feedback through the Steam community or our other communication channels (email, Instagram, Discord, or In-game) and make changes based on your feedback.

If you enjoy playing this game be sure to Wishlist the main release of The Time Game.

Features

  • Solo puzzles and Multiplayer, 2-4 Players.

  • Dynamic Board that changes each game.

  • Plan out how the future will unfold by creating rifts in time and deploying time bombs.

  • Utilize futuristic technology such as time machines, rail guns and force fields.

  • Tutorials and puzzles help new players understand the fundamentals, as well as teach some more intricate and mind-bending strategies.
